notion.howToAddRow: Create the row with ALL properties at creation time (setting properties later returns 400): _notion.createRecord({table:'block', parent:{id:collectionId, table:'collection'}, child_list_key:'', type:'page', properties:{title:[[t]], cat1:[[c]], date:[['‣',[['d',{type:'date',start_date:'YYYY-MM-DD'}]]]], due1:[[d]], stat:[['진행 전']], band:[[u,[['a',u]]]], quiz:[[q,[['a',q]]]]}}). Then row.children.addFromMarkdown('> 마감/밴드 원본\n## 퀴즈'), then embed block: _notion.createRecord({table:'block', parent:{id:rowId, table:'block'}, type:'embed', properties:{source:[[q]]}, format:{display_source:q, block_page_width:true, block_height:720}}), then addFromMarkdown('## 공부 순서 / ## 숙제 체크 (to-dos) / ## 정답 노트'). To fix a row, remove it and recreate.
